content:
alex: FYI - scim bulk reconcile for org 'opal-health' timed out at 03:12 UTC. It aborted with a partial apply. Seeing ~23 service accounts still present and 5 users retained admin after deprov run.

scim-bot: Job failed: context deadline exceeded
reconciler.go:312 applyBatch: timeout after 2m0s
last processed counts: users=1203 groups=41 applied=1175 errors=28

maria: ugh, is this the same reconcile that hit the DB deadlocks last month?

alex: different symptoms. no deadlock traces. the job clearly hit a hard timeout while streaming group members.

kevin: i've pulled the worker logs. looks like we got repeated KMS errors when trying to unwrap service account secrets used for downstream deprovision requests: 
```
ERROR: kms: Decrypt failed: resource not found for key projects/redwood-keys/locations/global/keyRings/scim/cryptoKeys/scim-aes
```
Trying to confirm if key was rotated or IAM on key changed.

maria: if KMS unwrap fails we skip remote API calls, which could leave entries in our local reconciliation state but not fully applied to downstream systems. that would explain orphaned SAs.

dina: opening an incident timeline and tagging customers that might be impacted. tentative scope: orgs with >1k users that ran reconcile in the last 24h.

oncall-sre: Deployed temp mitigation at 03:45 - increased reconcile timeout from 2m -> 6m and enabled retry-on-kms-unavailable for 3 attempts.

kevin: confirmed KMS key resource existed but IAM binding removed for service-account used by scim-worker. somebody removed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on scim-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com around 02:58 UTC.

maria: re-granted key decrypt role and kicked off a forced reconcile --force-reapply for opal-health. watch logs for duplicate apply markers.

alex: how are we preventing duplicate permissions from being re-granted in error? we need idempotency guard for reapply so we don't create duplicate bindings in downstream systems (some of those systems are eventual-consistent).

kevin: reapply already writes an apply-idempotency token to the reconciliation ledger, but the partial state from the timeout means a few operations were marked pending. I'll add a cleanup pass to convert pending->failed if last-update < now-5m before reapply.

maria: running cleanup now. will report counts in ~10m.

dina: opened INC-2026, adding postmortem assignee @alex and @kevin. also adding compliance note: need audit log export for KMS IAM changes to S3 for 90 days.

alex: good. next steps: (1) confirm all orphaned SAs removed after forced reconcile, (2) add transient failure handling for KMS unwrap + longer default timeout, (3) add alert on KMS IAM change for scim service account.

oncall-sre: alert rule proposal: if KMS Decrypt errors >5 in 5m for scim-runner -> page sec-oncall.

maria: cleanup finished. reconciled 23 SAs, 5 admin roles revoked. no duplicates observed. posting logs to the incident thread. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks. we'll document follow-ups in the postmortem and schedule a short runbook update to include the KMS IAM guard. :eyes:
